message: The physics-residual model adds a gradient-boosting residual to the recalibrated Stefan estimate; it is compared with three other structures under five validation splits.
medium: Scientific Reports, double column, 180 mm wide, fixed canvas (no tight bbox)

style.font: FreeSans 7 pt (thumbnail names, formula and annotations 6.5 pt, colour-bar ticks 6 pt), math variables FreeSans Oblique, panel letters 8 pt bold, all text black
style.lines: connectors 0.6 pt with open chevrons (no filled arrowheads); boxes face #EEEEEE, edge #333333 0.5 pt; Input/Model/Output regions dashed #B3B3B3
style.colour: accent only #D55E00: residual-ML path (gradient boosting -> residual -> plus node, applicability) and the ALT 2014 frame; training-only paths dashed grey #8C8C8C; input thumbnails cmcrameri grayC_r (one colormap), ALT oslo_r, residual vik (symmetric)
style.maps_c: Lena Delta, latitude-corrected lon/lat axes, land #EFEFEF, coastline 0.3 pt grey; test #D55E00, training #3A3A3A, excluded #B5B5B5; 50 km scale bar in the first map

layout: row 1: a (full-width structure diagram); row 2: b (four glyphs, one per quarter); row 3: c (five small maps with one shared legend)

a.years: example year 2014; applicability from the 2011-2024 mean map

c.source: polar.testbed_v5 load_v5 -> with_forcing('year_obs') -> usable_mask -> Lena rows -> make_folds(k 5, seed 0); verified against runs/core_v6/preds fold assignments
c.folds_shown: random r0, block b0, year 2016, block x year b0 x 2016, region L_Lena

qa: 2026-10-16: automatic QA 0 problems (69 texts; sizes 6/6.5/7/8 pt). Independent visual and scientific review applied: learner inputs drawn as a bracket over all eight thumbnails (TDD -> Stefan crosses it), model boxes equal height, strokes >= 0.5 pt, mathtext radical from FreeSans (no CM fallback font), applicability labelled '2011-2024 mean' (AOA computed from mean climate + static covariates in v5_map_predict.py), physics-input glyph shows 'Stefan, Kudryavtsev' (testbed_v5.run_method F1), training grey unified with Fig. 1 (#4D4D4D). Kept as briefed: test cells in vermillion. Caption notes: one example fold per split (random r0, block b0, year 2016, block x year b0 x 2016, region L_Lena); a cell is drawn as test if any of its cell-years is in the test fold; Physics ALT shares the ALT 2014 colour scale.

qa_automatic.checks: built-in qa(): font >= 6 pt, FreeSans only, text-text overlap, text outside canvas, text over foreign axes, in-axes labels touching lines/patches; pdffonts: FreeSans family embedded (CID TrueType); svg text kept as text
